Given Mississippi’s R+11 Cook PVI, the absence of contrary polling, and consistent characterization of the race as favoring Hyde-Smith, the best current estimate is that the Senate contest is R+ high single digits to low double digits, with the presidential race structurally R+ as well, though not directly polled in the last 45 days.
